claims.statement: For F=product_j chi_{R_j} f_j with arbitrarily reused character cores R_j in one shared block and pairwise-disjoint residual blocks, U(F)=sum_j U(f_j), G(F)=sum_j G(f_j), and I(F)=|triangle_j R_j|+sum_j I(f_j).
claims.scope: All finite dimensions, all factor counts, arbitrary reuse multiplicities and cancellations, arbitrary Boolean residual factors.

claims.statement: For every a>=0 and 0<=b<1, if each residual factor obeys G<=aI+bU, then the reused-character-core product obeys the identical pair with no additive or multiplicative loss.
claims.scope: Exact class closure; for a restriction-closed residual class this implies U<=aI/(1-b) and H<=(2+2a/(1-b))I throughout the generated overlap class.

claims.statement: Character-only shared cores are now exactly closed for U/G, but a non-character shared coordinate still creates a random posterior core and an unpaid joint signed four-channel collision term.
